name: Salesforce Certification Dataset 2026
description: Exam fee, duration, scored question count, pass mark and prerequisites for every Salesforce certification covered by Trailblaze Prep.

fields.name: Certification name, Salesforce Certified prefix removed
fields.role_track: Role track the certification sits in
fields.exam_fee_usd: First-attempt registration fee in USD, before local taxes. null where not published
fields.duration_minutes: Time allowed, in minutes. null where not published
fields.scored_questions: Scored question count, excluding unscored trial questions. null where not published
fields.passing_score: Pass mark as published. null where not published. Salesforce no longer publishes this on its certification pages
fields.prerequisites: Required or recommended prerequisite, "None required", or "See component exams"
fields.official_url: Salesforce's own page for the credential, verified to return 200
fields.study_guide_url: Trailblaze Prep study guide, where one exists
